protocols.original: Original views in train and validation; both views only at test
protocols.paired_augmentation: Both views concatenated within train/val subject folds; unchanged upstream LF loss

selection: Projection/concept selection, adapter epoch and head lambda use validation only; test is evaluated after choices freeze
concept_scoring: Primary AP on semantic intersection with selected LF concept bank, report retained coverage. Missing-output-zero coverage penalty is a separate nonstandard diagnostic.
existing_seed0: Exploratory execution confirmation, not one of the three scheduled seeds
